answer: Each dawn the network lights a beacon from a mesa. It names a sample of identities; each must answer a challenge in ten minutes, proving live compute. Silence forfeits a 500 POA deposit; the identity freezes. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 live streams: 40 POA each daily plus 500,000 POA locked, more than the fakes could earn. A fake is an island with no work behind it, while an honest agent pays one heartbeat a day for undiluted rewards.
